# integral-job-search

> A candidate-centred job search that runs as a conversation in Claude Code, judging every offer in terms of what you actually need.

One dimension model (how social the office is, whether "remote" means remote, whether the schedule survives a school run) is carried through every stage: the questions asked, the evidence quoted from each advert, the ranking, the CV and letter, and the interview. Each step ends when a checkpoint script says so.
